title: Walk to Downtown: Rooftop Deck & Hot Tub
description:
Important: Please do not instant book. Before booking, ensure both units in the photos are available. If you instant book, you will only reserve one unit, and it may not be the one shown in the photos.

Welcome to Nashville. Whether you’re here to explore live music, enjoy trendy restaurants, or experience the vibrant nightlife, this home offers a walkable location to Downtown, The Gulch and Music Row. After a day of adventures, unwind on the rooftop with stunning city views.

The space
If you’re looking for a comfortable place to relax and hang with friends in between your Nashville adventures, this is it. Less than a mile to Broadway, this 4 bed/4 bath home is in a topnotch location & offers stunning views of the Nashville Skyline, which you can admire from the rooftop’s hot tub. (Check for availability)

Guest access
There is a smartlock to get in.
